name: Materialism
overview: Scripture warns against the love of material wealth, emphasizing that a desire for silver or abundance leads to dissatisfaction and vanity (Ecclesiastes 5:10). Believers are instructed not to store up earthly treasures subject to decay and theft but to seek God's kingdom and righteousness first, with the promise that their needs will be met (Matthew 6:19, 33). Jesus cautions against covetousness, reminding us that life is not measured by possessions (Luke 12:15), and encourages generosity as a means to secure imperishable treasures in heaven (Luke 12:33). The parable in Mark 4:18 highlights how worldly concerns can choke the word of God, underscoring the spiritual danger of materialism.
